tool_calls.code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np
df = pd.read_csv('daily_cost_3.csv')
g = df.groupby(['SubAccountName','ServiceName'])['BilledCost']
# z-score within group
df['z'] = df.groupby(['SubAccountName','ServiceName'])['BilledCost'].transform(lambda x: (x-x.mean())/x.std())
top = df.reindex(df['z'].abs().sort_values(ascending=False).index)
print(top.head(10)[['ChargePeriodStart','SubAccountName','ServiceName','BilledCost','z']])
